title: Sprint plan/close tooling and dashboard upgrades
story: As leadership I run sprint plan and close commands and see review/retro, improvement log, team scorecards, tier spend mix and value drivers on one self-contained dashboard.
contracts: org/scorecards output shape defined in S1-PMO-01 brief
acceptance: node org/sprint.mjs plan <n> sums points of tickets with sprint n and writes committed list and committedPoints into org/sprints/sprint-<n>.json, preserving existing fields

node org/sprint.mjs close <n> writes review {completedPoints, committedPoints, usd, pointsPerDollar, firstPassAcceptance, reworkRate, testPassRate/testsPassed from org/quality.json} without discarding existing retro or other fields; exported pure functions planSprint and closeSprint are tested in tests/unit/org/sprint.test.mjs with a temp dir

Dashboard shows sprint review and retro text, improvement log (before/after/result from org/improvements.json), team scorecards with low-performer flags, model-tier mix of spend, and a value drivers panel listing VD-1..VD-6 with linked tickets via ticket.valueDrivers
New pure metric functions (tierSpendMix, valueDriverView, improvementLogView, or equivalent) have unit tests in tests/unit/dashboard/ that pass; existing metrics tests still pass
node dashboard/export.mjs still produces one self-contained HTML file (no external URLs, scripts and styles inlined) that renders gracefully when org/scorecards/latest.json is absent
brief: Part A, org/sprint.mjs: ESM, export planSprint(n, {tickets, dir}) and closeSprint(n, {tickets, quality, dir}) as pure-ish functions taking injected tickets/dirs so tests use a temp dir; CLI: node org/sprint.mjs plan|close <n> reads tickets via listTickets from org/fabric.mjs and org/quality.json. Read-modify-write org/sprints/sprint-<n>.json (see sprint-0.json for shape: committed, targets, review, retro); merge into review/committed, never drop retro. Completed points = done tickets in sprint; usd = sum ticket.spend.usd; pointsPerDollar rounded 1 decimal; firstPassAcceptance = done tickets with review.firstPass / done; reworkRate = reworkCount>0 share; guard divide-by-zero. Part B, dashboard: extend dashboard/metrics.mjs (add exports, keep existing ones and computeMetrics shape additive), dashboard/app.js, index.html, styles.css, and export.mjs so everything remains inlined into a single HTML file. Data: sprint review/retro from org/sprints, improvements from org/improvements.json (before/after/result), scorecards from org/scorecards/latest.json with shape {agents,configs,teams:[{key,ticketsDone,points,composite,lowPerformer,lowConfidence,diagnosis}]} produced by S1-PMO-01 (build against a local fixture in tests, tolerate file missing), tier mix = spend.usd grouped by ticket.tier, value drivers parsed from product/value-propositions.md headings '### VD-n' (VD-1..VD-6, title text) joined with tickets whose valueDrivers include the id. Escape HTML in all text. Look at the existing dashboard/server.mjs to see how the snapshot is built and extend it. Tests: tests/unit/dashboard/ new file(s) e.g. metrics-sprint1.test.mjs; run node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/dashboard tests/unit/org/sprint.test.mjs. Do not edit package.json; do not git commit.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 28 tests pass; export works with scorecards file absent (verified on a copy); VD-1..VD-6 with linked tickets, scorecard flags, tier mix, review/retro and improvement log present
